objectives.title: Game client
objectives.definition_of_done: Complete player-facing client flow from boot through stable gameplay.

objectives.title: Onboarding
objectives.definition_of_done: Title, world select, character creation, first-run flow and tutorial are verified.

objectives.title: World runtime
objectives.definition_of_done: Field rendering, movement, collision, camera, transitions and interaction runtime are verified.

objectives.title: UI and menus
objectives.definition_of_done: Required HUD, menus and navigation surfaces are implemented and verified.

objectives.title: Audio
objectives.definition_of_done: Required music, ambience and SFX are bound and verified.

objectives.title: Android client
objectives.definition_of_done: Installable Android build passes device smoke, lifecycle and packaging gates.

objectives.title: Gameplay systems
objectives.definition_of_done: Core Logres gameplay systems are implemented and verified end to end.

objectives.title: NPC and dialogue
objectives.definition_of_done: NPC interaction, dialogue and scripted interaction flows are verified.

objectives.title: Quests
objectives.definition_of_done: Quest accept, progress, completion, rewards and persistence are verified.

objectives.title: Encounters
objectives.definition_of_done: Field-to-battle encounter initiation and return paths are verified.

objectives.title: Battle
objectives.definition_of_done: Battle state machine, targeting, attacks, skills, effects, victory and defeat are verified.

objectives.title: Progression and jobs
objectives.definition_of_done: Levels, experience, jobs and progression rules are verified.

objectives.title: Items and equipment
objectives.definition_of_done: Inventory, equipment, drops, rewards and item persistence are verified.

objectives.title: Economy and crafting
objectives.definition_of_done: Required shops, currencies, enhancement and crafting flows are verified.

objectives.title: Recovered content
objectives.definition_of_done: Required recovered maps, actors, enemies, items, skills and quests are represented.

objectives.title: Maps and regions
objectives.definition_of_done: Target map and region coverage reaches the declared reconstruction scope.

objectives.title: NPCs and actors
objectives.definition_of_done: Target NPC and actor coverage reaches the declared reconstruction scope.

objectives.title: Enemies, bosses and skills
objectives.definition_of_done: Target enemy, boss and skill coverage reaches the declared reconstruction scope.

objectives.title: Items and equipment data
objectives.definition_of_done: Target item and equipment coverage reaches the declared reconstruction scope.

objectives.title: Quest content
objectives.definition_of_done: Target quest content coverage reaches the declared reconstruction scope.

objectives.title: Reconstruction fidelity
objectives.definition_of_done: Historical, behavioral, visual and asset fidelity gates pass or carry explicit ceilings.

objectives.title: Historical evidence
objectives.definition_of_done: Critical historical claims have provenance, confidence and explicit evidence ceilings.

objectives.title: Behavioral fidelity
objectives.definition_of_done: Critical runtime traces match the strongest supported reconstructed behavior.

objectives.title: Visual fidelity
objectives.definition_of_done: Required visual checkpoints pass machine-recorded comparison gates.

objectives.title: Asset fidelity
objectives.definition_of_done: Recovered assets are lineage-tracked from source evidence to runtime binding.

objectives.title: Quality and release
objectives.definition_of_done: Verification, performance, persistence, packaging and release gates all pass.

objectives.title: Automated verification
objectives.definition_of_done: Unit, E2E, regression and exact-SHA verification gates pass.

objectives.title: Performance
objectives.definition_of_done: Declared performance budgets pass on target devices.

objectives.title: Persistence and recovery
objectives.definition_of_done: Required player state persists and recovery paths pass.

objectives.title: Release candidate
objectives.definition_of_done: A reproducible Android release candidate passes every required mission gate.
